scope.purpose: Show free, interactive content in a non-modal panel anchored to a trigger.
alternatives: Dialog for a task that must be finished.

contract.scope: Popover contract: bindable open, required label, side, align; trigger Button or IconButton; non-modal dialog panel on color.surface.overlay with size.overlay.panel maximum; focus moves into the content, Escape, outside press and focus leaving close it; top layer.
contract.provenance: User at the grouped wave 3 contract gate in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c543GZBnpgBmqmSNfDLB (2026-11-03), on the review page https://claude.ai/artifact/3WoVBXoZev2vBWUUJny9A8 (version 3): "Je valide les 10 contrats. Ensuite : 1. ok (meme si le wording scrim n'est pas très parlant...) 2. Ok 3. Ok 4. Oui 5. Ok, à juger dans l'implémentation".

checks.name: npm run validate (schema, consistency, token coverage in 18 contexts, dependencies)
npm run build:tokens (coverage and contrast evidence)

decisionsTaken: Focus policy for non-modal popovers (left open by the spike): focus moves to the first focusable element of the content, or to the panel; Tab order follows the trigger; focus leaving closes it.
label required: the panel is a named non-modal dialog.
Surface color.surface.overlay, shadow.overlay, elevation border, radius.overlay, padding space.content.md, max inline size size.overlay.panel (new semantic role, 360 px), offset space.content.xs.
Side bottom or top, align start by default; flips, shifts and follows the trigger on scroll.
No built-in close button: content adds one when it needs it (Escape and a press outside always close).
nextAction: Implementation phase (ggb-svelte): component folder, examples page, SSR and browser tests, self-contained preview; Firefox and WebKit smoke projects before the first overlay implementation gate; then the grouped wave 3 implementation review.
